data: Which of the following components are included in the model architecture described in Figure 2?

The model architecture described in Figure 2 includes:

1. A bidirectional LSTM encoder.
2. A coarse-to-fine aligner.
3. A decoder.

These components are explicitly mentioned in the caption and can be visually identified in the figure. The bidirectional LSTM encoder is represented by two LSTMs connected in a bidirectional manner. The coarse-to-fine aligner is labeled as "Std. align." in the figure. The decoder is not explicitly labeled but can be inferred from the connections leading to the output symbols \( x_t \).
